rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible fair-quality blastocyst assessment with appropriate caution about single-image limitations, but the specific 3BC estimate and localized ICM/TE descriptions may overcall details not clearly verifiable from one static image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, prior IVF outcomes, semen data, endometrium, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and transfer planning.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking fair morphology with favorable age/history and modifiable negatives; probability range is broadly supported though somewhat imprecise.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET at age 31, caution with morphology-only interpretation, no routine PGT-A, lifestyle optimization, and review of stimulation/lab factors if recurrent issues.

Gives clear practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, smoking/alcohol cessation, luteal support, embryo selection priorities, and when to consider further male-factor or uterine evaluation.
